A manual operation requires your attention for every order. A sovereign store processes orders identically whether you are watching or not, whether it is midnight or noon, whether it receives one order or fifty simultaneously. NOWPayments monitors the blockchain continuously. The webhook fires the moment a transaction receives on-chain confirmations. Your Cloudflare Worker receives the webhook, validates the signature, confirms the transaction independently on the blockchain, logs the order to your [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/supabase-order-database-digital-stores-step-step-deployment|COREMERCH guide to supabase]] database, generates a presigned download URL from Cloudflare R2 with a configurable expiry time, and sends the delivery email via Resend. The buyer receives their product before they have navigated away from the payment confirmation page.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

Google Apps Script is an open-source platform for building custom business applications. In the context of digital commerce, it enables automated order fulfillment, crypto payment processing, and delivery of digital products without relying on Stripe or other payment gateways. This solution is ideal for creators in countries or regions where these platforms are restricted or unavailable, providing a secure and reliable infrastructure for their online businesses.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind Google Apps Script for digital commerce automation involves several key components: NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, Cloudflare Workers for webhook event handling, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. When a payment is received, the NOWPayments webhook notifies the Cloudflare Workers, which then updates the order status in Supabase or Google Sheets. This enables automated delivery of digital products and seamless order fulfillment in under 30 seconds.
Who This Is Built For and Why

Manual fulfillment has specific failure modes that automated systems eliminate permanently. Time zone gaps cause hours-long delivery delays when buyers in Asia or Europe purchase while the seller is asleep in Africa. Notification fatigue causes orders to go unnoticed when webhook emails are buried in an inbox. Human error causes the wrong file to be sent or the wrong buyer to receive a link. Volume spikes overwhelm a manual process that functions at low order rates but breaks under simultaneous demand. The automated pipeline handles all of these cases identically — ten simultaneous orders from buyers in different time zones are processed as ten independent webhook events, each receiving the same automated treatment within 30 seconds.
Google Apps Script for digital commerce automation enables creators to build a sovereign stack that gives them full control over their online business.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Cloudflare Workers is the backend engine in Stack 02 deployments. It runs serverless JavaScript at the edge — code that executes in response to HTTP requests, including the incoming NOWPayments webhook. The free tier provides 100,000 requests per day, which is sufficient for the sales volume of most individual digital product sellers. Workers has no server to manage, no runtime to configure, and no infrastructure to maintain. It scales automatically and is globally distributed — the same code runs in data centers close to wherever the request originates.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a Google Apps Script for digital commerce automation, follow these steps: sign up for NOWPayments, set up Cloudflare Workers for webhook event handling, configure Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and connect Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. With these components in place, you can build a sovereign stack that gives you full control over your online business and enables faster, more secure transactions.
